heading: Police and Fire Commission Opens a New Hiring Round
category: Sun Prairie Police and Fire Commission
summary: Police staff presented a plan and proposed dates for a new officer recruitment process. Commissioners discussed how the recruitment would relate to the existing eligibility list. They voted to authorize the new process.

heading: Wisconsin DOJ Updates Green Bay Officer-Involved Death Investigation
summary: State investigators issued an update on an August 21 death in Green Bay. The agency said officers were responding to a welfare check when a man brandished a firearm. The Division of Criminal Investigation was investigating the incident.

heading: Wisconsin Joins Challenge to Medicaid Coverage Restrictions
summary: Wisconsin DOJ joined a lawsuit over federal restrictions on using Medicaid funds for gender-affirming care for some young people. The coalition argues that states have authority to determine which services their programs cover. The lawsuit challenges the federal administration's attempt to limit that discretion.

heading: Wisconsin Opens Coastal Management Grant Applications
source: Wisconsin Department of Administration press release
summary: The state announced that 2027 coastal management grant applications were available as the governor proclaimed September Coastal Awareness Month. The Department of Administration also released the 2026 Great Lakes Chronicle. The announcement highlighted Lake Michigan and Lake Superior's role in Wisconsin's economy and recreation.
